title: FIDE Council composition for 2026–2030 announced
summary: Following the FIDE elections and the General Assembly held in Samarkand, FIDE is pleased to announce the composition of the FIDE Council for the 2026–2030 term. President and Deputy President 1.⁠ ⁠Timur Turlov (KAZ) – President2.⁠ ⁠Viswanathan Anand (IND) – Deputy President Elected Vice Presidents The General Assembly elected four FIDE Vice Presidents: 1.⁠ ⁠Yuhua Xu (CHN) – Vice President2.⁠ ⁠Michael Khodarkovsky (USA) – Vice President3.⁠ ⁠Pavel Kolobkov (RUS) – Vice President4.⁠ ⁠Yassin Souleiman Hassan (DJI) – Vice President Members nominated by the FIDE President The newly elected President nominated five additional members of the Council: 1.⁠ ⁠Luigi Maggi (ITA) – FIDE Treasurer2.⁠ ⁠Bouchra Kadiri (MAR) – Secretary of the Council / Vice President3.⁠ ⁠Mahir Mammedov (AZE) – Vice President4.⁠ ⁠Carol S. Williams Pesqueira (ARU) – Vice President5.⁠ ⁠Mykhailo Podolyak (UKR) – Vice President Honorary Vice-Presidents  The General Assembly also supported amendments introducing the position of Honorary Vice-President. The following candidates were proposed by the President for approval by the FIDE Council: 1.⁠ ⁠Rustam Kasimdzhanov (UZB)2.⁠ ⁠Javier Ochoa De Echaguen (ESP)3.⁠ ⁠Fouad Fahmi Darwish (UAE)4.⁠ ⁠Michael Stoettinger (AUT) Continental Presidents Under the FIDE Charter, the Presidents of the four Continental Associations are also members of the FIDE Council. The current Continental Presidents are: 1.⁠ ⁠Zurab Azmaiparashvili (GEO) – Continental President for Europe2.⁠ ⁠Benard Wanjala (KEN) – Continental President for Africa3.⁠ ⁠Sheikh Sultan Bin Khalifa Al Nehyan (UAE) – Continental President for Asia4.⁠ ⁠José Antonio Carrillo (PAN) – Continental President for the Americas
